speaker: charlie
text: Right, before we go we promised you an awe inspiring one and here it is. Right now off our very own coastline, humpback whales are hitting the peak of their spring migration, with thousands cruising past on their way back down south.

speaker: alice
text: Honestly it still gives me goosebumps, these massive gentle giants breaching just offshore while were all going about our normal Tuesday, well today its Thursday but you get me. Whale watching boats out of the Gold Coast and Sunshine Coast are having an absolute ball this week.

speaker: charlie
text: Its a proper reminder that this state of ours is a bit special, solar on the roofs, coral coming back on the reef and whales putting on a free show just past the breakers. Not bad for a Thursday.

speaker: alice
text: Not bad at all. Thats it for todays Bright Side, thanks for spending part of your morning with us.

speaker: charlie
text: Get outside, look after each other, and well catch you same time tomorrow. Cheers Queensland.
